events.title: Men’s Shed mayoral debate
events.detail: Candidate forum starts at 6:30 p.m.; mayoral debate runs 7:30–9 p.m. at St. Christopher’s Church.

events.title: Focus Burlington mayoral debate
events.detail: Meet ward candidates at 6:30 p.m.; mayoral debate starts at 7:05 p.m. at East Plains United Church.

events.title: All-candidates event and mayoral debate
events.detail: BurlingtonGreen and Safe Streets Halton host an all-candidates event and mayoral debate at the Art Gallery of Burlington, 6–9 p.m.

events.title: Online voting
events.detail: Online voting opens Oct. 14 at 8 a.m. and closes Oct. 23 at 6 p.m.

events.title: Advance voting
events.detail: In-person advance voting is available Oct. 17 and Oct. 20 at three citywide locations.

events.title: Election Day
events.detail: In-person voting runs from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. at locations in your ward.
